snippet.title: Wish Creatures Chapter 1 is Out Now!
snippet.description:
Play the Wish Creatures Chapter 1 demo in-browser right now!
https://fortexp.itch.io/wish-creatures-demo

Wish Creatures is an experimental Turn-Based Monster Taming RPG. Turn your Monsters into Stars and make wishes! The full game will release in Summer 2026.

We're almost there, girls. 💜
#indierpg #videogametrailer #freegame
